items.title: Last day to withdraw from the maintenance contract
items.quote: Sie können diesen Vertrag innerhalb von vierzehn Tagen ohne Begründung widerrufen.
items.computation: The contract was concluded on 20.11.2026 during the technician's home visit (a Haustürgeschäft under §312g BGB), and the withdrawal-information letter was handed over by the technician the same day, so no postal delivery-fiction rules apply – the document is in hand on 20.11.2026. The statutory 14-day withdrawal period under §355 Abs. 2 BGB is triggered by the conclusion of the contract, but under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event itself (20.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts the next day, 21.11.2026 (day 1). Day 14 falls on 04.12.2026 (21.11–30.11 = 10 days, plus 01.12–04.12 = 4 more days). 04.12.2026 is a Friday and not a public holiday in Hamburg, so the §193 BGB weekend/holiday extension does not apply. It suffices that the withdrawal declaration is sent off by this date.

warnings: The letter states the withdrawal period 'beginnt mit dem Tag, an dem der Vertrag geschlossen wurde' (begins with the day the contract was concluded); under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the counting itself still excludes that day, so the computed deadline (04.12.2026) relies on the standard statutory counting rule rather than a literal reading of this sentence.

The letter gives the contract term ('12 Monate ab 01.01.2027') but states no notice period or deadline for cancelling at the end of this term, so 'cancel_by' could not be determined – check the full contract/AGB for the applicable notice period.
The 19,90 € monthly price has no stated first due date in this letter; confirm the payment schedule in the full contract documents.
